text:
Jordan Lee: Morning — quick onboarding/security q: I sometimes dual-boot my personal laptop (Windows + Linux). Can I use it as a temporary dev machine? I run Docker and have SSH keys and some dotfiles synced to cloud. Also when do phishing sims run and will a fail be visible to my manager? :wave:

Maya Singh (Security): Welcome Jordan! Personal devices require an approved exception. If granted you must enroll the device in MDM, enable full-disk encryption (BitLocker/FileVault), install the company browser profile, and disable personal cloud sync for any work directories. We strongly recommend using the company loaner for dev work.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: "Security Basics" assigned to @Jordan Lee, due 14 days from start (1987654321). Course: https://learn.redwood/sec-basics

Diego Ramos: Phish sims run quarterly and are randomized. A single simulated-phish fail assigns a short remediation module; managers are not notified for single instances. Repeated fails may trigger an internal check-in.

Jordan Lee: Got it — I'll request the loaner. Can someone add me to #new-joiners and #sec-updates so I can get the checklists?

Elena Park (IT): Done — added to both channels and opened loaner request (IT-9012). We'll validate MDM/encryption before shipping. If you need a quick scrub of personal creds from the device, file a ticket and IT can assist. :thumbsup:
